Kuvitus: helteinen rantapiknik. Viltillä: Illustration: a hot beach picnic. An open cool bag with an ice pack and drink bottles sits on a blanket. The sun is shining, and a lake can be seen in the background.
Kuva kylmälaukusta ja energiankulutukses: Illustration of a cool bag and of energy needed. On the left is a cross-section of the cool bag: it is 28 °C outside, inside there is an ice pack and drink bottles at 0 °C, and a heat power P flows in through the walls, shown by two arrows of equal size. On the right are bars at the same scale for a mass of one kilogram: melting the ice takes 334 kJ, heating water by 10 K takes 42 kJ and by 80 K takes 335 kJ, so melting takes as much energy as warming by 80 kelvins.
Schematic of the cooling circuit of an engine. Waste heat from the engine is transferred to the liquid as a heat power P. The liquid travels along the upper pipe to the radiator at temperature T2 and returns along the lower pipe through the pump at temperature T1, and the radiator gives the same power P out to the air. The mass flow of the liquid is m/t. The picture is a diagram and not to scale.
